goal: Remove the global call_site_count and call_site_sha256 from the throughput truth audit by partitioning reviewed dispositions into one catalogue per source file, so two unrelated pull requests no longer serialise on a single artifact, while preserving every hand-written disposition and every refusal the guard makes today.
dispatcher: Owner Albert Hazan authorized resolving open non-orchestrator issues through to production
prohibited_actions: No database write, migration, function, view, role, grant, index, or timeout change.
Do not add a bulk regenerate or --update flag; every call site keeps its hand-written disposition and substantive reason.
Do not weaken, skip or make optional any existing refusal: unknown, stale, retired, duplicate, short-reason and uncatalogued sites must all still fail.
Do not edit another session's worktree or force any other lane to recompute.
assumptions: Issue 2832 is also Step 2 of the concurrently open planning PR 3318 under tracker 3306; this implementation follows that published design rather than a competing shape, and no implementation work had started there.
The pre-partition aggregate is retained as historical evidence only and is never read by the checker.
Generation 2 supersedes generation 1 only to express the disposition directory as a scoped glob; the goal, prohibitions and required checks are unchanged.
The evidence pair is rebound in a single commit on top of implementation head 9ce37888, which already carries the merge of main c477c8e8.
stop_conditions: Stop if the partition cannot preserve every existing disposition byte for byte.
Stop if hitting the throughput goal would require dropping any safeguard.
